summary: Improve digital support handoffs, accessibility, and complaint recovery. Explore the five-day course outline and plan your team's next steps.
lede: Digital customer service training helps contact-centre supervisors, service designers and customer operations leads improve continuity across support channels. Participants map handoffs, review interactions for accessibility using WCAG 2.2, and design complaint workflows and human escalation points for AI-assisted service. Practical exercises produce checklists and service artefacts for identifying gaps and prioritising improvements, without requiring coding or platform configuration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the quality, accessibility, and continuity of digital customer support. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with service channels, contact-centre processes, or customer operations.
prerequisites: Prior experience in customer service, contact-centre operations, customer experience, or digital support is recommended. No coding or software configuration is required.
